nutritionalGoals.title: 🥗 Core Nutritional Goals
nutritionalGoals.description: Based on your {category} category, prioritize a balanced intake of macros to optimize health and energy.
items: Avoid processed sugars and refined flours
Drink 3L+ water daily with mineral balance
Include green leafy vegetables in every meal
Prioritize lean proteins and healthy fats

supplements.title: 💊 Recommended Supplements
items: Omega-3 for heart and brain wellness
Vitamin D3 + K2 for bone and immune support
Optional Whey Protein for muscle recovery

tips.label: Sleep
tips.text: Target 7-9 hours of consistent night sleep.

tips.label: Routine
tips.text: Stick to fixed meal times to regulate hormones.

tips.label: Mindfulness
tips.text: Practice 10 mins of mindful eating/no screens.

tips.label: Movement
tips.text: Take a 15-min walk after your heaviest meal.
